Trees and their Soil
शुभोऽशुभर्क्षे रुचिरं कुभूमिजं करोति वृक्षं विपरीतमन्यथा।
परांशके यावति विच्युतः स्वकाद्धवन्ति तुल्यास्तरवस्तथाभिधाः।। 8 ।।
If the lord of the navamsha in the lagna is a benefic but
placed in a malefic sign it denotes the growth of beautiful trees
in bad soil. If on the other hand, the said lord is a malefic and
occupies a good sign it denotes the growth of a bad tree in a
good soil. The number of navamshas intervening between the
said lord's own navamsha and that occupied by him determine
the type that the tree has.
इति श्रीवराहमिहिरकृते बृहज्जातके वियोनिजन्माध्यायस्तृतीय: ।।3।।
Thus ends the third chapter on Non-human Birth in
Brihat Jatak composed by Varahamihira.
